name: GCP Cloud Storage — Buckets
description: Pull GCS buckets as cloud storage workloads for CNAPP data exposure analysis

steps.instruction: Open GCP Console → IAM & Admin → Service Accounts
Create a new service account (or select an existing one) and grant the 'Storage Object Viewer' role
Click the service account → Keys → Add Key → Create new key → JSON, then open the downloaded file
Copy the value of 'private_key' (the full PEM block including headers)

validation_request.error_message: Could not connect to GCP Cloud Storage. Verify the service account has Storage Object Viewer role on the project.
